title: QorCap device attestation sidecar
description: Sits beside receipt.json. receipt.v0.json rejects unknown fields, so this object is not a receipt field. See docs/DEVICE_ATTEST.md for what each field proves.

public_key_spki_b64.description: SubjectPublicKeyInfo, DER, standard base64. The name the referee reads.

non_exportable.description: CNG Export Policy at creation, or false for a software key, or null if the provider did not report. Not covered by the signature.

chain_head.description: Checkpoint hash that was signed. Not the video segment chain_head.

signature_b64.description: P-256: DER ECDSA-SHA256. RSA-2048: PKCS#1 v1.5 SHA-256. Standard base64, over the bytes in docs/DEVICE_ATTEST.md.

tpm.description: Present only when the provider returned attestation material. Optional. An unverified blob is not proof.
